Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

When the pensioner attends the Post Office, the Head/ Sub-Postmaster will, on proper identification of the pensioner, open a separate Savings Bank Pension Account with the credit of the first pension payment observing the normal procedure of opening.an SB Account. The Pensioner's half of PPO will be returned to the pensioner after making necessary entries.
